meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先派子代理去查文档、找出真实可用的 API，再按阶段写出一份可连续执行的实现计划，每阶段附文档出处、验证清单和要避开的反模式。
howto.when: 当你要求规划某个功能、任务或多步实现时触发，尤其在准备用 do 执行之前。

say.text: 帮我为这个新功能做一份分阶段实现计划
say.note: Claude 先查文档，再输出分阶段计划

say.text: 先查资料再规划：给登录模块写实现计划
say.note: 计划里会附文档出处和验证步骤

say.text: 把这个需求的实现拆成带验证清单的计划
say.note: 每阶段都会给出如何验证的方法

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude dispatches subagents to gather documentation and real API signatures first, then writes a phased, LLM-friendly implementation plan with an allowed-APIs list, per-phase verification checklists, and anti-pattern warnings.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation, especially before executing it with do.

say_en.text: Make a phased implementation plan for this new feature
say_en.note: Claude reads docs first, then outputs the plan

say_en.text: Gather docs first, then plan the login module
say_en.note: The plan cites doc sources and verification steps

say_en.text: Break this task into a plan with verification checklists
say_en.note: Each phase shows how to verify it worked
